Current liabilities stand at $500,000 (comprising $340,000 trade payables owed to timber merchants and a $160,000 bank overdraft).

Non-current liabilities total $900,000 in long-term bank loans. Total capital employed is $2,550,000, with shareholders' equity at $1,650,000 ($1,000,000 share capital and $650,000 retained profit reserves).
